failure_reason: Category/sub-category tree fully and reliably extracted (155 leaf PLPs under noon.com's own sitewide 'Pet Supplies' mega-menu, cross-verified against Home-Decor-pass access notes). However noon.com's listing-header widget only exposes an EXACT integer count for small result sets; any category above roughly 90-100 products is displayed as a rounded/threshold string (e.g. '300+ Results for', '1K+ Results for', '100K+ ...') with no exact figure anywhere in the SSR HTML, __NEXT_DATA__-equivalent payload, or a discoverable count API - this matches the precedent already recorded for this exact company in the prior Home-Decor pass (98/107 leaves null there for the same reason). Per project convention (QVC/H&M Home UK/Connox precedent cited in notes/165.md) this qualifies as partial rather than ok because a large fraction of leaf rows carry null qty + MANUAL REVIEW despite the category structure itself being complete and reliable.
notes: ACCESS: direct HTTP fetch via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome124) succeeded with HTTP 200 on every request (noon.com/uae-en/, /pet-supplies/, and all 155 leaf category URLs, plus robots.txt and sitemap-index.xml) - no proxy or browser automation needed, contrary to the prior pass's note that raw fetch returned only an empty SPA shell (site behavior/rendering must have changed since then, or the impersonation profile made the difference). robots.txt reconfirmed: generic 'User-agent: *' disallows only /_svc/ and /_vs/, while a separate 'User-agent: ClaudeBot' group explicitly 'Allow: /' with no restriction - consistent with notes/165.md. DISCOVERY: the site's own sitewide mega-menu is fully expanded as static <a href> links inside the SSR HTML of ANY catalog page (verified present identically on the /pet-supplies/ page and cross-checked that unrelated departments like Automotive and Baby Products also appear in the same markup, proving this is the global nav tree, not a page-scoped widget). Used this to enumerate the complete Pet Supplies category tree: Cats, Dogs, Fish and Aquatic Pets, Reptiles and Amphibians, Small Animals, Control Aids & Accessories, and Housing and Bedding (a cross-species top-level branch), 155 leaf categories total. QTY: each leaf fetched once; count taken from the PLP's own '_subTitle_uatw1_27' results header (e.g. "4 Results for" / Arabic "27 نتائج البحث" = exact; "300+ Results for" / "1K+ ..." = noon's own rounded/threshold display, NOT an exact count - per Rule 1 these are recorded as qty:null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than being treated as usable numbers). No storefront count API was used or trusted. OVERLAPS/DEDUPE: 'reptile-house/' and 'reptile-houses/' both existed as separate nav URLs under Reptiles and Amphibians with the same rounded count ('200+ Results for') and a heavily overlapping product set (14/14 sampled titles match, just reordered plus 2 extra on the 'houses' variant) - treated as one underlying listing/facet re-cut and merged into a single row 'Reptile Houses' (kept the more complete 'reptile-houses/' URL). Excluded a 'noon-supermarket/' sub-link that recurs under most category branches (cat-training-and-behavior-aids, food, grooming, health-supplies, litter-and-housebreaking, etc.) - confirmed via spot-check (cat-dry-food/noon-supermarket/) that this is a fulfillment/store-type facet cross-link (Noon's own grocery vertical), not a distinct product subcategory, consistent with the brief's navigation/facet-recut exclusion. EXCLUDED as non-category: all '?f[...]=' facet-filter query links (colour, deal_tag, delivery_date, fulfillment, grade, price, item_condition, min_offer_price, new_arrivals, partner), brand storefront pages (bioline, purina, royal_canin, rubies, sage_square, swacch, y_d, ggoot, generic, purepet, derby_originals, duvo_, kaytee, little_one, oxbow, padovan, petsafe, tough_1, weaver_leather, pets_first), and marketing/landing pages (pet-bulk-deals/, pets-bestsellers-ae/, supermall-all/). Individual PDP links surfaced only because their titles contained the substring 'pet' - excluded as product pages, not categories. FLAGS: pet-food/treat/supplement leaves (Cat/Dog Dry & Wet Food, Fish Food, Reptile & Amphibian Food, Supplements and Vitamins x2) flagged MANUAL REVIEW: PET CONSUMABLE per the brief's open policy gap. Treatment-type health leaves that read as medicine/parasiticide (Anti-Bacterial Treatments x2, Anti-Fungal Treatments, Insect Repellents x2, Flea/Lice/Tick Control x2, fish Medication) flagged MANUAL REVIEW: PET MEDICAL / VETERINARY CATEGORY per the brief's other open policy gap. Non-treatment health/wellness leaves (Anti-Stress, Cooling Aids, Wound Care and Body Supports, Ear Care) left unflagged as general pet-care/comfort items, not clearly medicinal. ABSENCE CHECK: not applicable - Pet Supplies is a large, clearly present top-level department on Noon UAE with its own breadcrumb-rooted URL path, confirmed via direct navigation (not site search).
